resources.string: Fetch and review the configured upstream. Existing commits keep their IDs; diverged histories create a merge commit. Conflicts may need manual resolution.
Updates %1$s with the reviewed %2$s commit. A merge commit may be created. Nothing is pushed.
Updates %1$s, then pushes its commits to %2$s at the reviewed push address. Conflicts stop publishing. A failed or unconfirmed push keeps the local Git result for explicit retry.
